scope: Acceptance of the five sampled motion criteria only; not full art approval or a continuous-performance assessment.

impact_recognition.evidence: In both profiles player turns solid white at 0.1 and 0.2 seconds, returns to normal by 0.4, and hull visibly drops from 35% to 27%. Adjacent small orange burst clearly differs from much larger filled fireball at 1 second.
impact_recognition.limitation: Persistent ring is a location cue rather than hit feedback; its constant appearance does not prevent recognition of the white flash.

smoke_fading.evidence: Initial burst dwindles by 0.4–0.6; large 1-second fireball disperses to thin smoke and embers at 1.5 and is absent at 2–3. Ongoing damaged-plane trail curves with turn; old burst does not persist as a solid blob.
smoke_fading.limitation: Connected trail resembles a granular chain, lacks soft volumetric breakup, and partly merges with fine dark water. Disappearance against texture can resemble fading.

wake_continuity.evidence: Carrier and escort wakes remain attached to sterns at all visible sampled positions and taper into ocean; regular oval stamps still evident.
wake_continuity.limitation: Repeated oval segments remain evident; connected placement passes but foam material lacks convincing turbulence.

camera_motion.evidence: Player approaches center then remains tracked through sampled turn. Cyan circle stays centered on player at all nine timestamps in each profile. Ships move consistently across view.
camera_motion.limitation: Sparse timestamps cannot establish interpolation smoothness or micro-jitter.

control_visibility.evidence: Bomb and Fire remain fixed and legible throughout both profiles, including escort behind Bomb at 3 seconds. Hull/heat/objective labels readable. Cyan ring clarifies player location on deck at 0.4–0.6 seconds.
control_visibility.limitation: Hawk label still intersects minimap edge at 2 seconds. Aircraft material partly merges with deck despite clearer location.

remaining_priorities: Improve smoke and wake materials beyond repeated granular/oval stamps.
Reduce fine water contrast to support faint effects.
Improve aircraft-to-deck contrast inside the useful player ring.
Prevent ally labels entering minimap and test dense combat motion separately.
limitations: No source/key inspected. No actual phone FPS inference. Sparse timestamps cannot prove continuous smoothness. Sequence has no shoreline, so it does not validate shoreline foam motion or naturalness.
inspection: All 18 motion-12 PNGs individually opened with view_image, plus motion-12/motion.json event timestamps. Verdict independently checked against same sampled criteria.
